papers.title: ChartZero: Synthetic Priors Enable Zero Shot Chart Data Extraction
papers.authors: Md Touhidul Islam, Yasir Mahmud, Sujan Kumar Saha, Mark Tehranipoor, Farimah Farahmandi
papers.affiliations: University of Florida
papers.intro: ChartZero提出一种仅基于纯合成数据训练的零样本图表数据提取框架，通过全局正交实例损失和开放词汇VLM引导的图例匹配，实现了对真实世界折线图的端到端重建，无需任何真实标注。

papers.title: CXR-ContraBench: Benchmarking Negated-Option Attraction in Medical VLMs
papers.authors: Zhengru Fang, Yanan Ma, Yu Guo, Senkang Hu, Yixian Zhang, Hangcheng Cao, Wenbo Ding, Yuguang Fang
papers.affiliations: City University of Hong Kong, Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School
papers.intro: 本文提出CXR-ContraBench，一个专门用于诊断医疗VLM中“否定选项吸引”现象的胸片矛盾基准，并引入无需重新训练的确定性验证器QCCV-Neg，可修复多数极性反转错误。

papers.title: Steering Visual Generation in Unified Multimodal Models with Understanding Supervision
papers.authors: Zeyu Liu, Zanlin Ni, Yang Yue, Cheng Da, Huan Yang, Di Zhang, Kun Gai, Gao Huang
papers.affiliations: Tsinghua University, Kolors Team, Kuaishou Technology
papers.intro: 本文提出理解导向的后训练框架UNO，将理解任务（字幕生成和视觉回归）作为直接监督信号反馈到生成表示中，显著提升统一多模态模型在图像生成和编辑任务上的性能。

papers.title: MaMi-HOI: Harmonizing Global Kinematics and Local Geometry for Human-Object Interaction Generation
papers.authors: Hao Wang, Shiqi Wang, Qi Liu
papers.affiliations: School of Future Technology, South China University of Technology
papers.intro: MaMi-HOI通过双适配器框架解耦宏观运动流畅性与微观几何精度，利用几何感知邻近适配器（GAPA）对抗“几何遗忘”以实现精确接触，并引入运动和谐适配器（KHA）主动调整全局姿态以保持运动自然性。

papers.title: Jointly Learning Structured Representations and Stabilized Affinity for Human Motion Segmentation
papers.authors: Xianghan Meng, Zhiyuan Huang, Zhengyu Tong, Chun-Guang Li
papers.affiliations: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications（北京邮电大学人工智能学院）
papers.intro: 本文提出时间深度自表达子空间聚类（TDSC），通过联合学习符合UoS分布的结构化表示和稳定化的亲和矩阵，实现准确鲁棒的人体运动分割，并在五个基准数据集上取得领先性能。

papers.title: Ray-Aware Pointer Memory with Adaptive Updates for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Feifei Li, Qi Song, Chi Zhang, Rui Huang
papers.affiliations: 香港中文大学（深圳）、清华大学
papers.intro: 提出一种射线感知指针记忆框架，通过显式编码空间位置和视角方向，结合保留-替换更新策略，实现流式3D重建中长序列的几何一致性和稳定记忆管理。

papers.title: $\mathcal{B}^{3}$-Net: Controlled Posterior Bridge Learning for Multi-Task Dense Prediction
papers.authors: Meihua Zhou, Li Yang
papers.affiliations: Wannan Medical University, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
papers.intro: 本文提出 $\mathcal{B}^{3}$-Net，通过将解码器侧跨任务交互分解为可靠性估计、后验桥构建和有界再分配三个可控步骤，实现了精度加权的后验桥学习与收缩更新，从而在多任务密集预测中取得更优的整体权衡。

papers.title: EgoEMG: A Multimodal Egocentric Dataset with Bilateral EMG and Vision for Hand Pose Estimation
papers.authors: Ziheng Xi, Jiayi Yu, Yitao Wang, Yanbo Duan, Jianjiang Feng, Jie Zhou
papers.affiliations: 清华大学自动化系（Department of Automation, Tsinghua University）
papers.intro: 本文提出 EgoEMG，一个包含双边腕部 EMG、IMU、第一人称 RGB、外部 RGB-D 和动作捕捉导出手部姿态的多模态 egocentric 数据集，并建立 EMG-to-pose、vision-to-pose 和 EMG+vision 融合三项基准任务及基线模型，推动多模态手部姿态估计研究。

papers.title: Adaptive Physical-Facial Representation Fusion via Subject-Invariant Cross-Modal Prompt Tuning for Video-Based Emotion Recognition
papers.authors: Xiwen Luo, Jia Li, Rencheng Song, Yu Liu, Juan Cheng
papers.affiliations: Department of Biomedical Engineering, and Anhui Province Key Laboratory of Measuring Theory and Precision Instrument, Hefei University of Technology (Xiwen Luo, Rencheng Song, Yu Liu, Juan Cheng)；School of Computer Science and Information Engineering, Hefei University of Technology (Jia Li)
papers.intro: 本文提出一个主体不变跨模态提示调优框架（SCPT），通过模态互补提示器（MCP）将rPPG时间-频率特征以提示形式注入冻结的ViT面部表情骨干，配合解耦共享-专用适配器（DSSA）显式分离主体共享和主体特异性成分，从而在保持面部语义的同时实现跨模态互补融合与跨主体泛化。

papers.title: R2H-Diff: Guided Spectral Diffusion Model for RGB-to-Hyperspectral Reconstruction
papers.authors: Songyu Ding, Ronggiang Zhao, Mingchun Sun, Jie Liu
papers.affiliations: 哈尔滨工业大学计算学部 (Faculty of Computing, Harbin Institute of Technology)；国家智慧农场技术与系统重点实验室 (State Key Laboratory of Smart Farm Technologies and Systems)
papers.intro: R2H-Diff提出了一种高效的扩散模型框架，将RGB到高光谱重建形式化为条件迭代细化过程，通过引导光谱细化模块和超光谱自适应转置注意力，仅用五步去噪步骤即可实现高质量重建，在NTIRE2022等数据集上以极低计算复杂度（0.58M参数，12.25G FLOPs）达到35.37 dB PSNR。

papers.title: EGA: Adapting Frozen Encoders for Vector Search with Bounded Out-of-Distribution Degradation
papers.authors: Dongfang Zhao
papers.affiliations: University of Washington（Tacoma School of Engineering and Technology）
papers.intro: 本文提出Euclidean Geodesic Alignment (EGA)，一种残差适应器，通过零初始化、局部三元组损失和超球面投影三个原则的组合诱导自限性训练动态——一旦已见类局部几何正确，适配器自动停止更新，从而在保持已见类精炼能力的同时几乎不破坏未见类区域，在多个OOD基准上取得最坏情况标签…

papers.title: Large Vision-Language Models Get Lost in Attention
papers.authors: Gongli Xi, Ye Tian, Mengyu Yang, Huahui Yi, Liang Lin, Xiaoshuai Hao, Kun Wang, Wendong Wang
papers.affiliations: 北京邮电大学（网络空间安全学院、网络与交换技术国家重点实验室、计算机学院）、南洋理工大学、中国科学院信息工程研究所、小米汽车
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于信息论和微分几何的统一框架，通过 RID 和 MixIG 两个指标量化 LVLM 残差流中注意力与 FFN 的更新作用，发现注意力主要是子空间保持的重配置操作，而 FFN 驱动语义创新，并且注意力权重存在严重冗余——用预定义值（如高斯噪声）替换学习到的注意力权重后，多数数据集上的性能…

papers.title: Sparse-to-Complete: From Sparse Image Captures to Complete 3D Scenes
papers.authors: Yiyang Shen, Yin Yang, Kun Zhou, Tianjia Shao
papers.affiliations: Zhejiang University
papers.intro: 本文提出S2C-3D框架，通过场景特化的扩散模型、无训练的多视角一致性条件采样和高效相机轨迹规划，从6-8张稀疏图像实现高保真、完整的3D高斯场景重建。

papers.title: AffectSeek: Agentic Affective Understanding in Long Videos under Vague User Queries
papers.authors: Zhen Zhang, Yuhang Yang, Yunxiang Jiang, Yuhuan Lu, Haifeng Lu, Zheng Lian, Runhao Zeng, Xiping Hu
papers.affiliations: Gansu Provincial Key Laboratory of Wearable Computing, School of Information Science and Engineering, Lanzhou University; Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Joint Laboratory for Emotional Intelligence and Pervasive Computing, Shenzhen MSU-BIT University; Department of Computer and Information Engineering, Khalifa University; Artificial Intelligence Research Institute, Shenzhen MSU-BIT University; Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, The University of Hong Kong; Shanghai Reasearch Institute for Intelligent Autonomous Systems, Tongji University
papers.intro: 本文提出了一个名为VQAU的新任务和对应的VQAU-Bench基准数据集，并设计了基于多智能体的AffectSeek框架，该框架通过分解推理步骤与跨阶段验证，实现了在长视频中对模糊用户查询进行主动情感时刻定位、情感分类和证据解释。

papers.title: Leveraging Image Generators to Address Training Data Scarcity: The Gen4Regen Dataset for Forest Regeneration Mapping
papers.authors: Gabriel Jeanson, David-Alexandre Duclos, William Larrivée-Hardy, Noé Cochet, Matěj Boxan, Anthony Deschênes, François Pomerleau, Philippe Giguère
papers.affiliations: Northern Robotics Laboratory, Université Laval, Québec, Canada; Département d’informatique et de génie logiciel, Université Laval
papers.intro: 论文利用视觉语言模型Nano Banana Pro同时生成高保真图像和像素对齐语义掩码，创建Gen4Regen合成数据集，并结合手动标注与伪标签真实图像统一训练，使语义分割F1分数比纯监督基线提升超过15个百分点，尤其对少数类别提升高达30个百分点。

papers.title: RAM-H1200: A Unified Evaluation and Dataset on Hand Radiographs for Rheumatoid Arthritis
papers.authors: Songxiao Yang, Haolin Wang, Yao Fu, Junmu Peng, Lin Fan, Hongruixuan Chen, Jian Song, Masayuki Ikebe, Shinya Takamaeda-Yamazaki, Masatoshi Okutomi, Tamotsu Kamishima, Yafei Ou
papers.affiliations: Institute of Science Tokyo, Hokkaido University, Hokkaido University, Hokkaido University, Southwest Jiaotong University, Hokkaido University, RIKEN / The University of Tokyo, Institute of Science Tokyo, Hokkaido University
papers.intro: 论文提出RAM-H1200——首个大规模、多中心、统一支持全手骨实例分割、像素级骨侵蚀分割和SvdH临床评分的手部X光数据集与基准，填补了定量骨侵蚀分析缺乏空间监督的空白。

papers.title: Text-to-CAD Retrieval: a Strong Baseline
papers.authors: Honghu Pan, Zibo Du, Daxiang Liu, Chengliang Liu, Xiaoling Luo
papers.affiliations: 湖南大学人工智能与机器人学院（Honghu Pan）；深圳大学计算机科学与软件工程学院（Zibo Du, Daxiang Liu, Xiaoling Luo）；澳门大学科技学院（Chengliang Liu）
papers.intro: 论文形式化定义了文本到 CAD 检索任务，并提出一种多模态表示学习框架——利用程序化序列和几何点云联合学习 CAD 嵌入，通过特征重构解码器实现隐式跨模态对齐，在两个基准数据集上建立了强基线。

papers.title: The First Controllable Bokeh Rendering Challenge at NTIRE 2026
papers.authors: Tim Seizinger, Florin-Alexandru Vasluianu, Jeffrey Chen, Zhuyun Zhou, Zongwei Wu, Radu Timofte, Dafeng Zhang, Yipeng Lin, Qi Yan, Junhao Chen, Yang Yang, Divyavardhan Singh, Hariom Thacker, Hammad Mohammad, Aanchal Maurya, Kishor Upla, Kiran Raja, Wei Zhou, Hongyu Huang, Yujin Cho, Grigory Malivenko, Jiachen Tu, Yaokun Shi, Guoyi Xu, Yaoxin Jiang, Jiajia Liu
papers.affiliations: 未在正文中明确列出，但作者注释表明组织者来自NTIRE 2026挑战赛，其他作者为参赛团队。具体机构信息需参考补充材料（Section A）。
papers.intro: 本文报告了NTIRE 2026首个可控散景渲染挑战赛的结果，对8种提交方法在保真度和感知质量两个维度进行了评估，发现多数方法基于Bokehlicious基线进行改进，但定量指标（PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS）与人工感知评分（MOS）之间存在弱相关性。

papers.title: Zero-Shot Satellite Image Retrieval through Joint Embeddings: Application to Crisis Response
papers.authors: James Walsh, William Fawcett, Grace Colvard, Raúl Ramos-Pollán
papers.affiliations: University of Cambridge (James Walsh, William Fawcett, Grace Colvard), Universidad de Antioquia (Raúl Ramos-Pollán)
papers.intro: 本文提出GeoQuery系统，通过提示对齐的文本代理（prompt-aligned text proxies）间接对齐冻结的CLAY视觉嵌入与文本嵌入，实现零样本卫星图像检索，并在灾害响应中验证其有效性。

papers.title: LAMP: Localization Aware Multi-camera People Tracking in Metric 3D World
papers.authors: Nan Yang, Julian Straub, Fan Zhang, Richard Newcombe, Jakob Engel, Lingni Ma
papers.tags: pose estimation, object detection, video search
papers.affiliations: ** Meta Reality Labs Research
papers.intro: LAMP 提出一种早期世界空间射线提升范式，通过利用头显已知的 6 自由度相机位姿将 2D 关键点提升为 3D 射线云，再使用端到端训练的时空变换器直接拟合 3D 人体运动参数，实现对多视角、异步、部分可见观测的鲁棒实时跟踪。
